name: Seba
overview: Scripture identifies Seba as both a son of Cush and a region associated with Ethiopia, highlighting its place in the genealogical and geographical framework of the Bible. Genesis 10:7 and 1 Chronicles 1:9 list Seba among the descendants of Cush, emphasizing its ancestral significance. Additionally, Psalms 72:10 and Isaiah 43:3 portray Seba as a nation known for bringing gifts and being part of God's provision, underscoring its role in God's sovereign plan and blessing to His people.
